settingsApplyNotice: Model and sandbox changes apply to new sessions.
rulesDescription: Configure custom instructions for Codex. AGENTS.md is read at the start of every session, so project conventions, commands, and preferences written here shape how Codex works.
mcpDescription: Add MCP servers to Codex. Global servers are stored in ~/.codex/config.toml and project servers in .codex/config.toml at the project root.
skillsDescription: Skills give Codex reusable instructions it loads on demand. Each skill is a SKILL.md file under ~/.codex/skills or the project's .codex/skills.
skillNamePatternError: Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens only (e.g. my-skill)
